channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump administration eases fuel efficiency standards for new cars
item.description: The administration says relaxed standards will lower car prices. Critics argue the change is not so simple and could harm the environment.

item.title: Prosecutors revisit Cornell fraternity rape case; here's what we know
item.description: New York prosecutors are reopening an investigation into an alleged 2024 rape at Cornell University. The alleged victim recently filed a lawsuit.

item.title: Trump's immigration crackdown has mostly spared farms, Idaho dairymen fear it may not last
item.description: U.S. farms have largely avoided the president's aggressive immigration enforcement. As ICE operations expand nationwide, farmers are growing uneasy.

item.title: SpaceX Starship Launches on First Orbital Mission from Texas
item.description: Starship is central to SpaceX's commercial goals and NASA's lunar landing plans. This marks the 14th flight of the uncrewed vehicle.
